title: Injiniyan Aiki a Wuraren Abokan Ciniki
meta: Salary aligned with the market + typical French benefits (Health Insurance, 50% Transportation card)
html:
Bayanin Aikin

Injiniyan Aiki a Wuraren Abokan Ciniki yana tsaye ne a mahaɗar dandalin Kyber na asali da wuraren da abokan cinikinmu suke amfani da shi a zahiri.

Za ka yi aiki kafaɗa da kafaɗa da tawagogin abokan ciniki domin haɓakawa, daidaitawa da kuma ƙaddamar da Kyber a yanayi na zahiri: wato mayar da SDK ɗinmu wata mafita da ta dace da na’urori, hanyar sadarwa da iyakokin jinkiri na kowane abokin ciniki.

Wannan aiki ba haɓaka manhaja ne kawai ba, kuma ba tallafin abokan ciniki ne kawai ba. Kai ne mai alhakin dukkan zagayen aikin a ɓangaren abokin ciniki: tantance buƙatu, tsara yadda za a haɗa tsarin, rubuta lambobin shirye-shirye, haɗawa da tsarin fasahar abokin ciniki, har zuwa kafa tsarin yadda zai yi aiki gadan-gadan.

Idan wani abu ya lalace a fagen aiki alhali saura ms 2 kacal na rata, kai ne mutumin da ya fahimci cikakken tsarin dandalinmu da kuma yanayin abokin ciniki sosai har zai iya gyara shi.

Za ka kasance tare da abokan ciniki a wurarensu domin samar da mafita cikin gaggawa, waɗanda aka tsara musamman dominsu, a cikin tsare-tsare masu sarƙaƙiya da ke ci gaba da sauyawa.

Muhimman Ayyuka:

  • Kasancewa cikin tawagogin abokan ciniki domin fahimtar injinansu, hanyoyin sadarwarsu da iyakokin aikinsu, sannan a mayar da su zuwa takamaiman buƙatun fasaha
  • Tsarawa, ginawa da ƙaddamar da hanyoyin haɗi na musamman ga kowane abokin ciniki bisa SDK na Kyber da matakin jigilar bayanansa
  • Daidaita tsarin aiki daga farko har ƙarshe domin cimma maƙasudai masu tsauri na ainihin lokaci (iyakar jinkiri, iyakar lokacin kowane hoto, rashin daidaiton lokacin isowa, asarar fakitin bayanai a kan QUIC)
  • Haɗa Kyber da na’urori da manhajojin abokan ciniki — masu motsa inji, na’urorin firikwensin, rafukan bidiyo da tsarin sarrafawa
  • Gano matsaloli da warware su a tsarin da ke aiki kai tsaye, sau da yawa ƙarƙashin tsauraran iyakokin jinkiri da amincin aiki
  • Isar da buƙatun abokan ciniki da darussan da aka koya a fagen aiki zuwa ga babban samfurin; da haɗa kai da tawagogin dandali da na lantarki wajen tsara gine-ginen tsarin
  • Rubuta takardun bayanan fasaha, jagororin haɗawa da misalan ƙaddamarwa na abin koyi
  • Gudanar da bitar lambobin shirye-shirye a matakin ƙwararre, da kuma kiyaye ingancin aikin injiniya a dukkan ayyukan da suka shafi abokan ciniki

Ƙwarewar da Ake Buƙata

  • Zurfin sani game da tsarin ciki na Windows da muhallan fasaharsa
  • Kyakkyawar fahimtar hanyoyin daidaita aiki tare, sarrafa ƙwaƙwalwa, da magance kurakurai a matakin tsarin aiki, tare da fayyacacciyar fahimtar iyaka tsakanin yanayin mai amfani da yanayin cibiyar tsarin aiki, da kuma sarrafa zaman masu amfani
  • Ƙwarewa ta aikace wajen amfani da kayan aikin gano kurakurai da nazari na Windows
  • Harsunan Shirye-shirye: C / C++ / Rust / x86/x64
  • Kayan Aiki da Muhalli: Visual Studio da kayan haɗa manhaja na Windows, GitLab da hanyoyin haɓaka manhaja na haɗin gwiwa

Game da Kai

  • Ƙwarewar shekara 3 zuwa 10 a fannin haɓaka manhaja, tare da tarihi mai ƙarfi na isar da tsare-tsare zuwa ainihin aiki
  • Ƙwarewa a Rust, C, ko harshen inji na matakin ƙasa — da iya karanta lambobin dukkan ukun da gano kurakurai a cikinsu
  • Ingantacciyar fahimtar tsare-tsaren ainihin lokaci masu ƙarancin jinkiri (iyakar jinkiri, iyakar lokacin kowane hoto, tsara jadawalin aiki, matsin baya na kwararar bayanai)
  • Ƙwarewa a tsare-tsaren sadarwa da yaɗa bayanai kai tsaye; sanin ƙa’idojin jigilar bayanai (QUIC, UDP, TCP) da fa’idodi da raunin kowanne
  • Sakin jiki wajen aiki kai tsaye da abokan ciniki: tattara buƙatu, tantance girman aiki, da bayyana shawarwarin fasaha a fili
  • Ɗaukar nauyin aiki kamar naka — ka saba da ɗaukar matsala tun daga buƙatar da ba ta fayyace ba har zuwa tsarin da aka ƙaddamar kuma yake aiki
  • Shirin yin tafiye-tafiye zuwa wuraren abokan ciniki da kuma yin aiki a muhallan aiki na zahiri

Ƙarin Ƙwarewa da Za Su Yi Amfani:

  • Ƙwarewa a fannin fasahar mutum-mutumi, jirage marasa matuƙa, motoci masu tuƙa kansu, ko sarrafa injina daga nesa
  • Gogewa a tsarin sarrafa bidiyo da kafofin yaɗa labarai ko sarrafa sigina (ƙwarewa mai alaƙa da VLC/FFmpeg ƙarin fa’ida ce)
  • Sanin SDR, tsare-tsaren da aka saka cikin na’urori, ko haɗa na’urori a matakin PCB
  • Gudummawa ga manhajojin buɗaɗɗen tushe
  • Ƙwarewar da ta gabata a matsayin injiniya a wuraren abokan ciniki ko a fagen aiki, ko kuma mai tsara mafita

Matakan Hira

  1. Kiran Tantancewa na Minti 15: Taƙaitacciyar tattaunawa game da ƙwarin gwiwarka da dacewarka, tare da amsa tambayoyinka da ba na fasaha ba.
  2. Hirar Fasaha da Samfuri Sau Biyu, Awa Ɗaya Kowacce: Zurfafa nazari kan yadda kake tunkarar warware matsaloli, tare da CTO ɗinmu da/ko babban mai tsara mafita namu
  3. Gaisawa da Tawagar: Zama na sakin jiki domin tabbatar da cewa ka dace da al’adun aikinmu.

Abin da Muke Bayarwa

  • Ayyuka masu zurfin fasaha da ke ƙalubalantar basira
  • Muhallin aiki da ke daraja ƙwarewar injiniya ta gaskiya kuma ya mai da hankali kan fasaha (babu taruka ko rahotanni marasa amfani)
  • Ayyuka masu ƙalubalantar basira a sahun gaba na fasahar sarrafa injina daga nesa a ainihin lokaci
  • Cikakken ’yanci wajen yanke shawarwarin fasaha
